title: Is Refusal Direction Universal across Low-Resourced Languages?
abstract: arXiv:2610.28897v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Refusal directions have been shown to transfer cross-lingually with near-perfect effectiveness across safety-aligned languages (Wang et al., 2025), reportedly regardless of resource level. However, the only truly low-resourced language evaluated is Yoruba, which is strongly misaligned and shows limited transfer, leaving open how refusal directions behave for other low-resourced languages. We extend PolyRefuse to three additional low-resourced languages (Belarusian, Bashkir, and Tajik) and replicate the pipeline of (Wang et al., 2025) on Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct. We find that universality is graded rather than binary: directions from safety-aligned and partially-aligned languages transfer broadly, while those from strongly misaligned languages fail to reliably modulate refusal behavior on any target tested, including other misaligned languages, once ceiling effects are accounted for. translated_title: 拒绝方向在低资源语言中是否具有普适性？
translated_abstract: 拒绝方向已被证明能够在安全对齐的语言之间以近乎完美的效果进行跨语言迁移（Wang et al., 2025），且据称不受资源水平的影响。然而，此前评估中唯一真正的低资源语言是约鲁巴语，该语言属于强失对齐语言且表现出有限的迁移效果，这使得拒绝方向在其他低资源语言中的表现仍是一个悬而未决的问题。我们将 PolyRefuse 扩展到另外三种低资源语言（白俄罗斯语、巴什基尔语和塔吉克语），并在 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 上复现了（Wang et al., 2025）的实验流程。我们发现，普适性是分级的而非二元的：来自安全对齐和部分对齐语言的拒绝方向能够广泛迁移，而一旦考虑天花板效应，来自强失对齐语言的拒绝方向则无法在任何测试目标上可靠地调节拒绝行为，包括其他失对齐语言。几何对齐与行为迁移进一步表……
tldr: 该研究发现拒绝方向的跨语言普适性是分级的而非二元的：来自安全对齐语言的拒绝方向可广泛迁移至低资源语言，而来自强失对齐语言的拒绝方向则无法可靠地调节任何目标语言的拒绝行为。
en_tdlr: This study finds that the universality of refusal directions is graded rather than binary: directions from safety-aligned languages transfer broadly to low-resourced languages, while those from strongly misaligned languages fail to reliably modulate refusal behavior on any tested target.
